name: Uonari Setsuna
source:
A kuro-gyaru student who is popular with the girls.

With her short, streaked hair, and fashion sense, she looks like a "prince," but inside she's just a normal girl. She herself says that she's "only a prince in appearance."

Towa sometimes teases her about being popular with the girls.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/gyaru/index.html]official site[/url]]
